Test Scenario: Flight booking deducts wallet balance correctly
Test Case: Verify wallet balance after successful flight booking
Preconditions: 1. Partner wallet Active 2. Sufficient Available Balance (Cash/Credit) 3. Note opening balance (Total Available / Cash / Credit / Reserved Holds)
Steps: 1. Note opening wallet balances from dashboard 2. Search + select flight via API 3. Create booking and complete payment via API 4. Confirm booking success 5. Refresh Partner Wallet dashboard 6. Open Transaction History for the booking ID
Expected Result (API + Wallet Dashboard): 1. Total Available decreases by exact booking amount 2. Reserved Holds = 0 after commit 3. Transaction shows Booking payment (Debit / Red) with status Committed 4. Amount matches API fare 5. Booking ID visible in transaction sub-text

Test Scenario: Flight booking deducts wallet balance correctly
Test Case: Verify Hold appears during flight payment before commit
Preconditions: 1. Sufficient balance 2. Ability to pause/observe mid-payment if possible
Steps: 1. Note opening balances 2. Start flight booking payment via API 3. Check wallet immediately after hold is placed (before final commit) 4. Complete payment 5. Re-check wallet
Expected Result (API + Wallet Dashboard): 1. On hold: Reserved Holds = booking amount; Total Available reduced by hold 2. Transaction type Hold (Orange) pending 3. After success: Hold clears; Debit Committed; Reserved Holds back to 0

Test Case: Verify full refund on cancellable flight booking
Preconditions: 1. Successful flight booking already committed 2. Booking is refundable / within cancel policy 3. Note balance after booking
Steps: 1. Note post-booking balances and committed debit amount 2. Cancel booking via API 3. Confirm cancellation success + refund amount from API 4. Refresh Wallet dashboard 5. Expand booking transaction row
Expected Result (API + Wallet Dashboard): 1. Total Available increases by refund amount 2. Credit/Release entry (Green) appears linked to same Booking ID 3. Net wallet impact = original debit − refund (per policy) 4. Expand row shows Hold → Committed → Release breakdown

Preconditions: 1. Booking with partial refund or cancellation fee
Steps: 1. Book flight 2. Cancel via API 3. Compare API refund vs wallet credit 4. Check dashboard entry
Expected Result (API + Wallet Dashboard): 1. Wallet credit = API refund only (not full fare if fee applies) 2. Debit remains; separate Release/Credit for refunded portion 3. Final Available = Opening − fare + refund

Test Case: Booking payment fails when Available < fare
Steps: 1. Attempt flight or hotel payment via API 2. Check API error 3. Refresh wallet
Expected Result (API + Wallet Dashboard): 1. API returns insufficient funds / payment failed 2. No Committed debit 3. Reserved Holds unchanged (0) 4. Total Available unchanged

Test Case: Top-up increases Available then booking deducts correctly
Steps: 1. Note balance 2. Complete wallet top-up 3. Verify Credit Completed entry 4. Book with new balance 5. Verify debit
Expected Result (API + Wallet Dashboard): 1. Top-up: +amount Credit Completed; Available increases 2. Booking: Debit Committed for fare 3. Final Available = Opening + top-up − fare

Test Case: Verify Total Available = Cash + Credit Available (Holds separate)
Steps: 1. Read Total Available Cash Reserved Holds Credit Available 2. Compare formula 3. Place a hold then re-check
Expected Result (API + Wallet Dashboard): 1. Total Available = Cash Balance + Credit Available 2. Reserved Holds shown separately (not inside Available) 3. On Hold: Available drops; Reserved Holds rises by same amount

Test Case: Verify legend statuses and expandable booking group
Preconditions: 1. At least one completed booking + one cancel/refund if possible
Steps: 1. Open Transaction History 2. Match Debit/Credit/Hold colors and statuses 3. Expand a booking row 4. Cross-check amounts with API
Expected Result (API + Wallet Dashboard): 1. Green = Credit/Release; Red = Debit Committed; Orange = Hold 2. Booking groups Hold + Commit + Release under one Booking ID 3. Amounts and timestamps match API 4. VIEW ALL shows full history

Test Case: Verify deduction prefers correct balance source
Preconditions: 1. Mix of Cash > 0 and Credit Available > 0 (if supported)
Steps: 1. Book amount less than Cash 2. Book amount greater than Cash but within Credit 3. Check Cash vs Credit cards after each
Expected Result (API + Wallet Dashboard): 1. Balances update on correct card(s) per product rules 2. Total Available always reflects sum after each booking 3. Transactions amounts still exact

Test Case: Flight book → hotel book → cancel one → verify running balance
Steps: 1. Note Opening O 2. Book flight (amount F) → verify O−F 3. Book hotel (amount H) → verify O−F−H 4. Cancel one (refund R) → verify O−F−H+R 5. Check all related transactions
Expected Result (API + Wallet Dashboard): 1. Running Available matches formula at each step 2. Correct Committed + Release entries 3. No orphan holds left (Reserved Holds = 0 at rest)

Test Case: Abandoned payment releases hold and frees balance
Steps: 1. User A starts payment → Hold placed 2. Do not complete payment; wait for hold expiry/timeout (or abandon per API) 3. Check wallet 4. User B then books amount X
Expected Result (API + Wallet Dashboard): 1. After timeout: Reserved Holds = 0; Available restored 2. Hold released (Green release or hold cleared) 3. User B can pay successfully
